title: Validate the complete algorithm rather than a postselected training program
statement: At each fixed classicalcode/rankguess, independent complete candidate blocks give IID Bell failure for the averaged fresh-service channel. Adaptive confidence allocations sum over all reachedtrials; Bell validation does not select/reuse a particular gauge-dependent training state. Supergeometric stage reach tails pay exponentially growing trial costs under the coding promise. Soundness concerns ever selecting a bad reduced fresh channel, not per-record posterior accuracy or exact rank discovery.

requires: Fixed stationary memoryless source chosen independently of encoder seed; trusted paid known encoders and endpoint pads
True unknown payload before encoding, protected coherent storage and supplied logical dimension
For blind selection, actual fresh complete candidate training/Bell validation/service blocks and qualifiedrank/dimension regime for completeness

assumptions: The unknown payload is available BEFORE known encoding. Logical Weyl/Pauli keys are applied before source encoding and retired after decoding. No released-key, every-seed, source-memory/seed-responsive noise or already encoded-only input guarantee follows. Fresh full training is required for validation AND service; no stored gauge program is reused. Soundness does not certify rank; expected polynomial termination needs the actual coding/rank/dimension regime. Complexity is polynomial ink, notlogk. Klesse/randomcoding and decoupling are established priors; no high-rate architecture, hardware or practical advantage.

Countable adaptive confidence allocation and sufficiently fast reach tail to pay growing candidate cost; fixed cap is a distinct contract
